home-par1: AGHIST is the search portal for agricultural, food, and environmental history. It is operated by the Archives of Rural History (ARH) and provides direct access to online resources (films, photos, and written sources, as well as catalog data, scholarly texts, video essays, etc.) made publicly available by the ARH and its partner institutions in Switzerland and abroad.
home-par2: With AGHIST, you can search for information on a person, an institution, an archival collection, or a film. But the search portal is also suitable for thematic searches. For example, anyone interested in learning more about the importance of women in the agricultural sector, the development of the agricultural policy of industrialised states, the resource base of agriculture, or the difference between mechanization and motorization will find useful information here.
